sources.entry: Traccar - Java application to track GPS positions. Supports loads of tracking devices and protocols, has an Android and iOS App. Has a web interface to view your trips. (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 Java

summary.name: Traccar
summary.one_liner: Traccar is free and open source GPS tracking software that you can self-host or use through managed hosting.
use_cases: run a self-hosted GPS tracking server
summary.what_it_does: Traccar supports a wide range of GPS trackers and protocols, from affordable devices to professional hardware. Devices can be followed in real time on road maps or satellite imagery, with location updates shown alongside sensor readings. Users can get push or email notifications for geofence crossings, harsh driving, fuel drops, and maintenance events. Trips, charts, summaries and location history can be reviewed on a map, and reports can be accessed on the web or mobile app and exported to Excel. The software can run on Windows, Linux, or other platforms, on your own hardware or in the cloud, or through managed hosting.
notable: Supports a wide range of GPS trackers and protocols
Can turn a phone into a GPS tracker
Self-host for free or use managed hosting with professional support
Open source under Apache-2.0 with live demo
caveats: Managed hosting with professional support is a paid option; pricing details are not on the page
Page does not state detailed pricing for managed hosting
